objective: Preallocate join-path schema lookup keys from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate JOIN schema keys
tasks.result: Join scan and planning schema lookups now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for schema:<table> keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for schema:<table> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in join base scan, comma-join reorder planning, right probe schema loading, and first-relation projection pruning schema loading.
Generated schema key bytes, join planning, projection pruning, row-cache behavior, and SQL join results are unchanged.
